mods.name: MCTun
mods.description: High-performance SOCKS5 tunneling over a Minecraft Fabric client/server connection.

releases.notes:
Changes:
- Add DIRECT client mode: app -> client SOCKS5 -> target, without joining a Minecraft server.
- Keep TUNNEL mode as the default existing Minecraft server tunnel path.
- Support DIRECT CONNECT, BIND, UDP ASSOCIATE, no-auth, and username/password auth.
- Preserve old client config compatibility by defaulting missing mode to TUNNEL and writing it back.
- Keep netty-codec-socks packaged as a nested jar.

Validation:
- GRADLE_USER_HOME=/private/tmp/mctun-gradle-home ./gradlew test
- GRADLE_USER_HOME=/private/tmp/mctun-gradle-home ./gradlew build
- Verified mctun-0.1.3.jar contains META-INF/jars/netty-codec-socks-4.1.97.Final.jar and DirectSocksManager classes.
- Real DIRECT client-only test passed with curl, UDP ASSOCIATE echo, and BIND peer socket flow.

releases.notes:
## Fixes
- Fixed production installs failing to initialize the local SOCKS5 listener with `NoClassDefFoundError: io/netty/handler/codec/socksx/v5/Socks5ServerEncoder`.
- Packages `netty-codec-socks` as a nested jar in the Fabric mod artifact.
- Aligns the bundled SOCKS codec dependency to Netty `4.1.97.Final`, matching the Minecraft 1.21.1 runtime line observed in production logs.

## Validation
- `GRADLE_USER_HOME=/private/tmp/mctun-gradle-home ./gradlew test`
- `GRADLE_USER_HOME=/private/tmp/mctun-gradle-home ./gradlew build`
- Verified `mctun-0.1.2.jar` contains `META-INF/jars/netty-codec-socks-4.1.97.Final.jar`.

mods.name: MCTun
mods.description: High-performance SOCKS5 tunneling over a Minecraft Fabric client/server connection.

releases.notes:
## Changes
- Added a low-latency fast path for MCTun custom payloads by handling tunnel frames at the Minecraft ClientConnection Netty layer before Fabric dispatches to render/server threads.
- Kept the same Minecraft server connection and port; no separate data port is introduced.
- Batched WINDOW_UPDATE frames to reduce reverse control-frame overhead.

## Validation
- `GRADLE_USER_HOME=/private/tmp/mctun-gradle-home ./gradlew test`
- `GRADLE_USER_HOME=/private/tmp/mctun-gradle-home ./gradlew build`
- Real Fabric server/client quickplay test over `127.0.0.1:25565`.
- TCP persistent echo overhead P50: `0.146ms`.
- TCP SOCKS+MCTun connect overhead P50: `0.428ms`.
- UDP echo overhead P50: `0.141ms`, MCTun UDP P99: `0.573ms`.
- Cloudflare speed samples showed no observed throughput regression in this run.

mods.name: MCTun
mods.description: High-performance SOCKS5 tunneling over a Minecraft Fabric client/server connection.

releases.notes:
Initial public release of MCTun.

Highlights:
- Fabric 1.21.1 client/server mod.
- SOCKS5 listener on the Minecraft client.
- Tunnel path: SOCKS5 app -> Minecraft client -> Minecraft server -> destination.
- CONNECT, BIND, and UDP ASSOCIATE support.
- Username/password authentication support.
- Basic TCP backpressure, UDP malformed/drop counters, and integration tests.

Validation:
- ./gradlew build
- Real Fabric runServer/runClient smoke test
- CONNECT via curl through 127.0.0.1:1080
- UDP ASSOCIATE echo test
- BIND bidirectional socket test
